ui.inertia-navigation: Downgraded, not disabled, as in statamic-automations: every hit stays visible in each report.
The rule is right that axios plus a manual page reload skips Inertia's progress bar, flash
toasts, dirty guard and back button. The inbox does not do that: page changes go through
router.visit/router.reload, the progress bar is started by hand around each call, the dirty
state is registered with Statamic.$dirty, and toasts go through Statamic.$toast.
What the hits are: calls to the addon's JSON endpoints (routes/cp.php), which answer with a
body the page needs in place. The draft endpoint returns the suggested text, the template
endpoint the filled text, the connection test IMAP and SMTP results, the reply endpoint the
stored message or why it failed (502 keeps the text in the form), the mailbox store the new
edit URL, the conversation update the new state. router.post() expects an Inertia page
response and cannot hand any of that back without a reload that would lose the typed reply.
